-86.82050,35.95070.name: Vanderbilt Fertility Clinic
-86.82050,35.95070.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

120.87338,24.68373.name: Agricultural Input and Product Valorization Research Center (AIPVRC)
120.87338,24.68373.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Agricultural Technology Research Institute. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-63.61179,44.68348.name: Bedford Institute of Oceanography
-63.61179,44.68348.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, March 2025
-63.61179,44.68348.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. A site of Fisheries and Oceans Canada. Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, March 2025. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

38.75000,9.03000.name: African Biodiversity Network / farmer seed systems
38.75000,9.03000.desc: Works on farmer-managed seed systems across east and southern Africa, where most seed still moves through exchange rather than purchase. Every seed law reform on this continent is a decision about whether that remains lawful, and the people it affects most are the least represented in the drafting.

-77.04180,38.84820.name: Post-harvest monitoring — the obligation that outlasts the trial
-77.04180,38.84820.state: Riverdale, Maryland — APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services
-77.04180,38.84820.desc: A release permit does not end at harvest. It typically requires the site to be monitored for volunteers for one to several seasons afterwards, with the land left fallow or planted to something that makes volunteers visible, and the results reported. This is the part of a trial a neighbour lives beside, and it is knowable: the permit states the monitoring period, and the permit is public. If a site was cropped normally the season after a trial, that is a specific and checkable question to ask.
